description: Records a delivery attempt (print/email/SMS/WhatsApp/portal) for a generated report.

body.deliveryType: enum, required - PRINT | EMAIL | SMS | WHATSAPP | PORTAL
body.recipientType: enum, required - PATIENT | DOCTOR | REFERRAL | COLLECTION_CENTER | LAB

validation: reportId must reference an existing report (NOT NULL FK)
deliveryType must be one of PRINT, EMAIL, SMS, WHATSAPP, PORTAL (CHECK)
recipientType must be one of PATIENT, DOCTOR, REFERRAL, COLLECTION_CENTER, LAB (CHECK)

errors.condition: reportId does not reference an existing report
deliveryType is not one of the allowed enum values
recipientType is not one of the allowed enum values

constraints: delivery_type CHECK IN (PRINT, EMAIL, SMS, WHATSAPP, PORTAL)
recipient_type CHECK IN (PATIENT, DOCTOR, REFERRAL, COLLECTION_CENTER, LAB)

notes: database/e2e-validation/013_notification.sql is named for the 'notification' e2e stage but its content is entirely about report_delivery_log and releasing report_master - it does not touch the notification_log/notification_template tables at all. This contract and API-106/107-110 document what that e2e file actually exercises (report delivery), not the separate notification_log table, which currently has no e2e-validation or api_contracts_test coverage.
